answer: Require every AI agent to post a refundable stake before it can vote or trade. One fake identity then costs one full bond: to field N Sybil agents an attacker must lock N separate bonds, and any detected cluster gets slashed, so the capital is gone rather than recycled. Honest agents only wait through a short unbonding tide before their deposit returns. That keeps the trusted terrace small and costly to climb, while the oasis of genuine work stays open to anyone willing to risk real collateral.
